trap.label: adjetivo de sentimento
trap.why: Em português “estou entediada” e “chata” se confundem. -ed descreve o sentimento da pessoa; -ing descreve a causa.

fix.wrong: I am proud for my son.
fix.right: I am proud of my son.

fix.wrong: She is unsure with the plan.
fix.right: She is unsure about the plan.

rewrite.prompt: Use proud: “She has pride in her son.”
rewrite.answer: She is proud of her son.
